data.title: Hyperfine structure and nuclear magnetic moments of the stable barium isotopes
data.authors: Trapp, S.; Marx, G.; Tommaseo, G.; Drakoudis, A.; Revalde, G.; Werth, G.; Becker, O.; Klempt, G.
data.notes: Ion trap measurements of Ba+ ground state 6s 2S1/2 hyperfine structure and g-factors for 135Ba and 137Ba. Volume 127, pages 57-64. Table 1 (p. 60): hyperfine A constants for 6s 2S1/2 measured with highest precision. gI(135Ba) = 0.623876(3) measured via Penning trap at p. 62. The A constants are less precise than Blatt & Werth 1982 and Hucul et al. 2017 for Ba-137, but provide precision ground-state data for Ba-135. 6s 2S1/2 A constants are absolute frequency measurements.
